fields.description: Issue features a major report alleging a Miami-area bankruptcy "ring" and calling attention to investigations involving bankruptcy officials and attorneys, with discussion of the Miami Beach gas company bankruptcy and related dealings. Editorial content criticizes city administration and discusses theft and prosecution, alongside a traffic-safety campaign emphasizing automobile accident deaths and enforcement of traffic rules. The issue also continues Miami Life’s city-wide "Most Attractive Working Girl" contest (Courthouse winner Mary Buckley) and includes local columns, Miami Beach development commentary, and racing/turf tips and other entertainment and advertising content.
